informal_statement: Let C and D be categories and F : C ≃ D an equivalence of categories. If a cospan (f : X → Z, g : Y → Z) admits a pullback (P, π₁, π₂) in C, then (F f, F g) admits a pullback (F P, F π₁, F π₂) in D, and F induces an equivalence between the categories of pullback cones over (f, g) and over (F f, F g).
proof_path: existing theorem alignment via Equivalence.preservesLimitsOfShape specialized to pullbacks
fallback_path: constructive cone transport using unit, counit, and full faithfulness
next_action: Confirm the exact mathlib theorem for pullback preservation under equivalence before promoting this package to L1.
